recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If display text for comma-separated LOINC `in` values remains incomplete, address that in Publisher/tooling rather than reverting the core value set definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-48766 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by OO and asked that Observation Vital Signs profile value set definitions bound through Observation.code use LOINC `in` filters where appropriate to avoid repeated compose.include blocks.
initial_application: Rob Hausam pre-applied the change in f628a0a04e, merged as HL7/fhir PR #3210 via 53031256e3, changing nine Observation vital-sign value set XML files from repeated includes to comma-separated LOINC `in` filters. Later commits touching the same files changed metadata/status rather than the filter semantics.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, the Observation packs list includes ImplementationGuide/Observation-vitalsigns, that IG references the vital-signs profile family, and Observation.code binds to ValueSet/observation-vitalsign-measurement, which composes the specific vital-sign value sets. OO minutes record both support for the LOINC `in` simplification and a Publisher display-text limitation; no later linked Jira or Zulip evidence was found that reverses the source decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current nine affected value sets each contain exactly one LOINC op=`in` filter with comma-separated LP values, matching the applied issue request.
